scripts.postinstall: node -e "try { const {execSync}=require('child_process'); execSync('find node_modules/.pnpm -type f -name esbuild -exec chmod +x {} +', {stdio:'ignore'}); execSync('find node_modules -type d -name .bin -exec chmod -R +x {} +', {stdio:'ignore'}); } catch (e) {}"
scripts.build: cd apps/web && npx vite build && node -e "try { require('fs').cpSync('../../dist/apps/web', '../../dist', { recursive: true }); } catch (e) {}"
